violated_contract: Offline sync merge must not append transcript lines that already exist on the conversation when the same spoken audio arrives on a different absolute time base (live stream started_at vs WAL filename timestamp / mild RTC drift).
canonical_prevention: Dedupe merge candidates with exact absolute ranges, exact conversation-relative ranges, then batch-gated text+slop for clock-offset re-uploads; skip private-cloud chunk upload when any lines were dropped so full-source WAV cannot reintroduce duplicate audio.
